review.why: Plans and reads A/B tests: hypothesis, sample size, metrics, peeking rules and result interpretation, plus an ongoing experiment program.
review.summary: Starts from a structured hypothesis, one change per test and a pre-set sample size, with a quick sample-size table and metric roles (primary, secondary, guardrail). It covers variant design, traffic allocation, a launch checklist, the peeking problem and careful p-value and interval wording, then an ICE-scored backlog and an experiment playbook.
strengths: Careful statistical wording that follows the American Statistical Association's statement
Advice for opt-in elements: analyze the exposed group, not all visitors
Playbook template and cadence for continuous experimentation
cautions: Detailed sample-size tables and test templates are in files not read here
Needs enough traffic: low-traffic sites get little from it
